title: The High Holy Days — Tradition Overview (Edition 1)
description: Rosh Hashanah, the New Year, and Yom Kippur, the Day of Atonement, are Judaism's holiest days, forming a season of repentance. The shofar, a ram's horn, is sounded on Rosh Hashanah. This overview edition presents The High Holy Days within the world's religious landscape, factually and without favor.
